attestation.note: Verified against https://verdikt.aismith.ai: / and /health return 200, /ui/ redirects to sign-in, HSTS is sent, and TLS is a Let's Encrypt certificate valid to 2026-12-15. On the deploy host, web, worker, Postgres, Redis and MinIO are all up, with web, Postgres, Redis and MinIO reporting healthy; the database is at migration 0040. Deployed commit: 41bde65. The two defects open at first deploy (http asset URLs on an https page, and a missing landing video) are fixed and live: the page serves no http asset URLs and the landing video plays from YouTube. Three hardening items are still open; they are listed as pending under Readiness.

readiness.one_liner: Live on self-hosted infrastructure behind a Cloudflare tunnel, with model inference on Nebius Token Factory. 19 of 22 items are done; the 3 pending items are hardening that is not finished on the live host.

items.name: /health endpoint
items.detail: https://verdikt.aismith.ai/health returns 200 with {"status":"ok"}.

items.name: Version-freeze byte-identical
items.detail: Two consecutive renders of the same input JSON must produce byte-identical version_hash. Enforced in tests.

items.name: Admin auth (bcrypt)
items.detail: DOCGEN_ADMIN_PASSWORD_HASH generated with hash_password(); no plaintext in the app config.

items.name: Nemotron reasoning path
items.detail: Contract-tested against a Nebius Token Factory fixture, and exercised on prod by emailed test cases on 2026-10-18.

items.name: Retriever warm-up
items.detail: pgvector store seeded from rules/*.yaml; the embedding endpoint is first reached on the first retrieve() call, not at boot.

items.name: Boundary tests (AI vs render)
items.detail: docgen.core never imports docgen.providers; pap_pipeline never imports docgen. Enforced mechanically.

items.name: License audit gate
items.detail: CI job fails the build if a non-permissive third-party licence lands.

categories.name: Infrastructure
categories.description: The deploy host, DNS, TLS and model access. All in place.

items.name: Host provisioned
items.detail: Self-hosted server running Docker Engine + Compose. The stack runs as its own compose project, apart from anything else on the host.

items.name: DNS pointing at the deploy host
items.detail: https://verdikt.aismith.ai resolves through Cloudflare and serves. Apex host; the www. label is not configured.

items.name: No public inbound ports
items.detail: The tunnel connects outbound from the host, so the web container is not exposed on a public port.

items.name: Docker Engine + Compose installed
items.detail: Installed on the deploy host; stack brought up with compose.

items.name: Nebius Token Factory API key
items.detail: Issued and in use. Every model call resolves through Token Factory.

items.name: TLS certificate (Let's Encrypt)
items.detail: Let's Encrypt certificate at the Cloudflare edge, valid to 2026-12-15.

categories.name: Security & operations
categories.description: Hardening controls. Three are not finished on the live host.

items.name: HSTS
items.detail: DOCGEN_HSTS_ENABLED=true on prod; the live site sends Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains.

items.name: Secure-cookies flag
items.detail: DOCGEN_SECURE_COOKIES is false on prod. Sign-in failed with it on during the first deploy, so it was turned off to unblock. Needs to go back to true once the tunnel's https scheme reaches the app.

items.name: Trusted proxies for the tunnel
items.detail: DOCGEN_TRUSTED_PROXIES is still 127.0.0.1 from the Caddy plan. With the tunnel in front, it should list the hop that actually forwards requests to the web container.

items.name: .env file permissions 600
items.detail: Checked on the deploy host on 2026-10-18: -rw------- (owner only).

items.name: Admin credential rotation
items.detail: The admin password has not been rotated since the first deploy. Rotate it and the session secret; the judge demo sign-in is a separate tenant-level account.

live.one_liner: Live at https://verdikt.aismith.ai, self-hosted, with all model inference on Nebius Token Factory. Status below is attested by probing the public endpoints and the compose stack on the host. There is no automated probe yet.

services.name: Web (docgen)
services.role: FastAPI app: admin UI + inbox + pipeline
services.detail: Container healthy. https://verdikt.aismith.ai/health returns 200. Judge demo sign-in is on.

services.name: Worker
services.role: Background jobs: pipeline runs, mapping, freeze, publish, inbox polling
services.detail: Polls the demo mailbox every 60 s. Prod is the only stack that polls it; dev has polling off so two pollers never race.

services.name: Postgres
services.role: Primary datastore: programs, rules, packages, decisions
services.detail: Container healthy. Migrations run by a sidecar before web/worker start; at head (0040).

services.name: Redis
services.detail: Container healthy. Ephemeral; no persistence required.

services.name: MinIO (object store)
services.role: Rendered PDFs, source PDFs, extracted assets

services.name: TLS edge (Cloudflare tunnel)
services.role: Public :443 at Cloudflare's edge, tunnelled to the web container; Let's Encrypt certificate
services.detail: TLS terminates at Cloudflare's edge and the tunnel carries traffic to the compose stack.

services.name: Nebius Token Factory
services.role: External: hosts every model the pipeline calls
services.detail: Prod calls it on every case: MiniCPM-V (ingest), Nemotron Nano (triage), Qwen3-Embedding-8B (retrieve), Nemotron Super (reasoning fallback). Verified end to end on 2026-10-18 with emailed test cases, including an approved case whose reply email arrived.

endpoints.name: Demo mailbox
endpoints.expect: Email in → case in the inbox → reply after approval
